description: The chart illustrates the performance of two models, NESAC ft model and SESHA ft model, under various optimizations. The vertical axis lists the optimizations applied, including Normalised, Add Spacing, Remove Spacing, Americanisms, and Dates, while the horizontal axis represents the value, ranging from 0.000 to 0.003 in increments of 0.001. The chart features grouped bars, with each group representing an optimization and containing two bars: one for NESAC ft model in orange and one for SESHA ft model in green. The NESAC ft model bars have values of 0.00334 for Normalised, 0.00319 for Add Spacing, 0.00311 for Remove Spacing, 0.00299 for Americanisms, and 0.00257 for Dates, while the SESHA ft model bars have values of 0.00323 for Normalised, 0.00344 for Add Spacing, 0.00306 for Remove Spacing, 0.00302 for Americanisms, and 0.00228 for Dates. The bars are not sorted in a specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
